metadata.evidence: The OntoMathPro ontology has been developed by a [research group](https://github.com/CLLKazan) from Kazan Federal University (Russia). This ontology is bilingual (English/Russian) and is geared to be the hub for math knowledge in the Web of Data. We shared the sources with the Semantic Web community to engage our colleagues from elsewhere in its further development. We are going to create an ecosystem of datasets and mashups around the ontology.
metadata.reason: The artifact name is explicitly mentioned as the ontology name.
